notes: The prior C7 inventory declared 34 directories; the current tree contains 42 after eight additional source/analysis directories were added.
Existing executables are candidates only; they are not treated as current builds until rebuilt or explicitly marked source-only.
This inventory is ordinary research bookkeeping and is not an execution or approval gate.
Current live vertical artifacts include hardened L1TEX/SFU/result-queue/completion probes; their lower-bound mismatches and open tails remain negative or partial evidence, not timing activation.
Population entries with live stages now carry explicit live_status/live_artifact; entries without these fields remain uncaptured or analysis-only and are not counted as complete.
M1/M2 corrected v2 artifacts supersede the earlier AO/AP claim text; v1 rows remain historical raw evidence.
M3 audit completed: touched analyze.py modules now use the active long-generation populations; historical short-trace outputs remain raw evidence and are not execution prerequisites.

M4-C added twelve same-binary vertical records: seven previously uncaptured Makefile families, five source/preserved-binary families, and fresh v2 repairs for safe bypass and SMSP contention. Every current CUDA-backed directory now has a live artifact or explicit wrapper/source disposition; LDGSTS retains two wrong-launch NCU attempts and one bounded trace timeout.
M4 source review added pinned Makefiles for the five formerly source/preserved-binary families; generated executables are ignored and rebuildable from source.

M5-A reconciliation retains the 36 pre-M4 live rows and appends the twelve M4-C current vertical rows; population entries continue to point at their latest artifacts while earlier rows remain historical.
C7-S33BD reconciled the stale 31-row build matrix: six current Makefile probes received bounded make checks on 2026-10-05 and appended, yielding 37/37 passed rows.
